candidates.snippet:
Air Force One soars into the sky over Florida as President Trump heads back to the nation's capital.

The presidential aircraft departs Donald J. Trump International Airport following Trump's weekend at Mar-a-Lago, with arrival at Joint Base Andrews expected later this evening. h
Watch live coverage as James Talarico holds a Senate campaign rally in Plano, Texas, on the Fox News app. Download here: https://t.co/Q8qTIP81ow
